standard_prerequisites.name: Super linear and enveloping algebra foundations
standard_prerequisites.reference: Graded tensor/sign convention in169 onward; classical PBW theorem for Lie superalgebras, Milnor–Moore referenceMM
standard_prerequisites.use: Formal inverse series, homogeneous basis/sign rules, PBW and filtered-algebra lifting. The RTT-to-current associated graded theorem, central-series construction and the current-center lemma are retained author work, not free inputs.

core_obligations: Construct the central antipode series via the rank-one Q operator and the RTT identity, then identify the leading symbols of all nonconstant coefficients.
Prove triviality of the enveloping current-algebra center after quotienting the scalar Lie center, and lift the resulting free generators through the Yangian filtration.

difficulty_reason: Centrality alone does not give all central elements or independence. The proof coordinates a rank-one RTT residue construction, a nontrivial leading-filtration cancellation and a maximal-current-degree invariant argument to obtain complete free generation. These remain concrete H2 obligations beyond the previously counted PBW theorem.

compared.difference: Old Theorem2.8 identifies the associated graded algebra with the current enveloping algebra; it is uncounted support and does not classify the Yangian center.

compared.difference: Different characteristic and object; its p-center mechanism is absent over C, and it does not assert free generation by Nazarov antipode-series coefficients.

dedup.scope: Same-source old primary and closest super-center primary compared directly; local manifest/preparation/research/retired source+claim metadata used to exclude exact reuse. Quantum Berezinian is a later alternative description and not additionally counted.
